title: Process-based Self-Rewarding Language Models
authors_zh: Shimao Zhang、Xiao Liu、Xin Zhang、Junxiao Liu、Zheheng Luo、Shujian Huang、Yeyun Gong
paper_type_zh: 后训练数据、偏好、奖励或评测研究
best_for_zh: 研究 LLM 后训练反馈数据与 verifier 的读者。
one_line: Process-based Self-Rewarding Language Models addresses process-based self-rewarding supervision.
过程式自奖励把长思维、逐步 LLM 裁判和逐步偏好优化引入数学推理的自奖励流程。
why: It exposes a feedback, preference, reward, rubric, safety, or post-training data surface that must be audited before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on process-based self-rewarding supervision with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: Process-based Self-Rewarding is motivated by a concrete failure of outcome-only self-improvement: a model can assign a plausible score to a completed mathematical solution while failing to distinguish the first invalid transformation from the valid prefix that precedes it. If an entire trace is rejected, learning may suppress correct reasoning together with the bad step. The paper therefore changes the feedback unit from a completed response to a localized process event in a long thought.
过程式自奖励针对结果级自我改进的一个具体失败：模型可能给完整数学解答一个看似合理的分数，却无法区分“第一个无效变换”和它之前的有效前缀。若拒绝整条轨迹，学习会把正确推理与错误步骤一起压低。因此论文把反馈单位从完整回答改为长思维中的局部过程事件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The model plays two roles in one iterative system: it writes long reasoning traces as a policy and judges individual transitions step by step. Stepwise preference optimisation then trains the next model to retain correct prefixes and prefer corrected continuations; policy and judge share operational definitions of a step and local validity. It converts sparse final-outcome feedback into supervision localised to the reasoning process, supporting training and exposing divergence points.
所提模型在同一迭代系统中扮演两个角色：作为策略写出长推理轨迹，作为逐步裁判评价轨迹中的单个转移。训练信号随后是逐步偏好优化，使下一代模型保留正确前缀并偏好纠正后的续写。这比只要求 LLM 给最终答案打分更强：裁判与策略必须共享“什么是一条步骤”和“局部有效性如何定义”的操作性定义。

title: Method
方法
html: Each round creates or receives reasoning problems, generates long CoTs, segments them, obtains stepwise LLM-as-a-Judge decisions, and constructs chosen/rejected supervision. Reproducibility requires recording problem source, seed model, prompts, delimiters, sampling, judge schema, pair-selection rule, and iteration count. Inputs are problems, traces, and intermediate states; outputs are step labels, preferences, or continuous rewards. Reproduction should verify the generator, terminal verifier, sampling budget, and filtering rules.
每轮中，流水线创建或接收推理题，生成长思维候选，将其切分为步骤，获得逐步 LLM-as-a-Judge 判断，再构造优选/拒选监督进行优化。下一策略在这些数据上训练，并成为后续迭代的生成器/裁判。可复现记录必须包括题目来源、种子模型、轨迹提示、步骤分隔符、候选采样设置、裁判提示与输出 schema、成对选择规则和迭代次数。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Evidence should be checked against the primary paper: tasks, sample counts, step segmentation, label provenance, metrics, and outcome-supervision baselines. Official code and downloadable data are recorded only when identified by the primary source; a paper link is not itself an artifact link. Reproduction should record versions, seeds, verifier environment, and representative failures.
论文在数学推理基准上评估该迭代过程，并报告相对结果级自奖励基线的提升。这些结果只能视为特定长思维、裁判和优化闭环的证据，不能证明每条思维链都忠实，也不能证明模型获得了通用验证器。即使基座相同，轨迹格式、裁判指令或最终答案抽取一变，表现也可能改变。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with one label for a whole chain of thought, this work changes the unit or acquisition path of process evidence. The model plays two roles in one iterative system: it writes long reasoning traces as a policy and judges individual transitions step by step. Stepwise preference optimisation then trains the next model to retain correct prefixes and prefer corrected continuations; policy and judge share operational definitions of a step and local validity. Its reusable contribution is the data contract, quality control, and evaluation boundary.
最关键的设计选择是让裁判定位并比较过程状态，而不是只给完成答案贴标签。这为自生成反馈提供了针对可恢复局部错误的路径。新意在把长思维、逐步裁判和逐步偏好优化共同放入自奖励迭代；单独使用过程奖励模型、自训练或 DPO 并不是首次。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Long traces can be persuasive but unfaithful; arbitrary segmentation shifts errors across boundaries; self-judges favour familiar wording; repeated training amplifies blind spots. Independent verification should audit step labels. Process scores support training or search but do not replace executable checks, human review, or domain expertise; transfer requires sample audits.
多种误差会叠加：长轨迹可能有说服力却不忠实；任意切分会把错误移过边界；模型裁判可能偏好自身熟悉措辞；重复训练会放大初始盲点。数学基准的最终答案通常易核查，而许多现实任务没有公认的中间谓词。应以独立验证审计步骤标签，并比较保留与移除生成理由时的结果。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the method for research on reasoning post-training where intermediate validity can be inspected, such as math, code with execution, or formal derivations. It is useful for separating “the model got the final answer wrong” from “the model first went wrong here.” It is not a generic safety-alignment recipe, and should not be used to expose private chain-of-thought or to infer that a natural-language rationale is a faithful account of model computation.
适用于研究可检查中间有效性的推理后训练，例如数学、可执行代码或形式推导。它能区分“最终答案错了”和“从这里开始走错了”。它不是通用安全对齐配方；也不应暴露私人思维链，或把自然语言理由当作模型计算的忠实说明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the released code and data with the paper and preserve all intermediate artifacts. A serious run logs initial SFT/EFT data, task sampler, model checkpoints at every iteration, raw traces, step indices, judge scores/reasons, discarded ties, pair construction, optimizer, and held-out evaluation. Report judge quality independently from policy quality; otherwise a policy improvement can conceal a deteriorating self-judge or vice versa.
应结合论文阅读发布代码和数据，并保留所有中间工件。严肃实验要记录初始 SFT/EFT 数据、任务采样器、每轮检查点、原始轨迹、步骤索引、裁判分数/理由、被丢弃的并列、成对构造、优化器和留出评测。应把裁判质量和策略质量分开报告，否则策略提升可能掩盖自裁判恶化，反之亦然。

title: Citation
引用
html: Zhang et al. (2025), “Process-based Self-Rewarding Language Models,” arXiv:2503.03746. Primary paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.03746. Consult the ACL Findings version for the final experimental protocol and do not conflate this process-based method with the earlier outcome-oriented Self-Rewarding Language Models paper.
